name: Baraona (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle with its vertices at the lower fly corner and the midpoints of the hoist and the upper edge, charged at the upper hoist with a red castle.
history: The flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a red cloth with a white triangle whose vertices are at the lower fly corner and the midpoints of the hoist and the upper edge, with a red castle in the upper hoist canton.

features.role: triangle with its vertices at the lower fly corner and the midpoints of the hoist and upper edge
